title: Service connections
description: Providers own protocol and endpoints; Connections manage account identity, scopes, and Secret references. Credential plaintext never enters page state.
needWorkspace: Create or join a Workspace first
createNeedProvider: Finish Provider endpoint and auth contract setup first
migrationBannerBody: After the hard cutover, legacy shared-account connections are DISABLED + MIGRATION_REQUIRED and cannot run. OWNER/ADMIN should open edit and choose Broker/OBO or request passthrough.
emptyBody: Create a service connection, then let Tools reference it for business actions.
emptyNoMatchBody: Try different connection name, host/IP, or auth keywords
discardBody: This service connection form has unsaved edits. Discarding will not save them or use them for later verification.
deleteBody: After deletion, any Binding or default connection that references this Connection is checked by backend integrity rules. The page does not submit manual reference counts.
deleteConfirmLabel: Type the connection name to confirm
formCreateSubtitle: Select a Provider and fill in auth identity. Endpoints are maintained on the Provider.
formEditSubtitle: Update account, authorization, and Secret references. Endpoint settings stay read-only.
basicInfoHelp: Select Provider and auth method. You can verify the Connection right after save.
providerHelp: A Provider is a reusable service API definition for endpoints, protocol, and discovery. A Connection only stores account and credentials for one environment. Create one via “Register Provider” in the top-right, then select it here.
outboundStrategyHelp: Choose Broker/OBO or request passthrough only. Shared account / NONE / a third mode are not allowed.
migrationWizardBody: Legacy auth is shown read-only for comparison. Choose a target policy, fill configuration, save and verify to clear migration state. Mode is never inferred automatically.
noOutboundContractTitle: Provider has not declared a user outbound contract
noOutboundContractBody: Declare BROKER_OBO or REQUEST_PASSTHROUGH on the Provider, then create the connection.
impactBody: Related runs will use the new policy version after the switch; in-flight temporary tokens become invalid. Secret / Token / Broker body are not shown.
impactSummary: Impact summary: published Tools / Agent bindings / Workflow Revisions (server impact proof issued).
brokerHelp: Requires Subject · config-level verification · per-user token exchange. Machine credentials are config-only; responses never echo Secret.
machineCredentialKeep: Leave blank to keep existing; enter a new value to replace
machineCredentialHelp: Config-only; user business tokens are not stored. Configured: {value}
passthroughHelp: Requires Subject · token on every request · user business tokens are not persisted.
passthroughResidenceHelp: Default 600 seconds; tokens stay only in this run’s in-memory Vault.
advancedSettingsHelp: Provider runtime endpoint and auth execution summary (read-only)
dedicatedRefreshPlaceholder: Fill when different from the access-token endpoint
availableForTools: This connection can be used by Tools
verificationAfterAddress: Shown after the service address is filled
checkAddressDesc: Whether the host, port, and base path form a reachable address
checkCredentialDesc: Fixed token, API key, or auth endpoint can produce an injectable access credential
checkTestCallDesc: Request the verification endpoint with the current credential; status and body match expectations
checkRefreshDesc: Expired credentials can be handled with the current policy
phaseSavedButVerifyFailed: Connection saved, but verification did not pass
phaseSavedButVerifyRequestFailed: Connection saved, but verification request failed
loadFailedRetry: Load failed. Please try again later.
reasonNeverVerified: No verification has been run for this connection.
reasonLastVerificationFailed: The latest verification failed. Run it again for current diagnostics.
reasonVerificationExpired: A previous verification exists, but the connection must be verified again.
reasonNeedsVerification: Verification is required before Tools can rely on this connection.
credentialPlacementAuthInject: Inject header after auth endpoint response
brokerModeHint: Exchange machine trust for a short-lived business token for the current user; user tokens are not stored
passthroughModeHint: Caller attaches a token per run; it cannot be recovered after the run ends
validationNoOutboundContract: This Provider has not declared a user outbound contract (supportedModes). Finish setup in Provider management first.
validationOutboundModeRequired: Select an outbound identity policy: Broker / OBO or request passthrough this time.
validationOutboundModeUnsupported: The selected policy is not in the Provider supportedModes.
validationBrokerMachineCredential: Enter a machine credential (private key PEM).
validationNoAuthContract: This Provider has not published an auth contract. Finish setup in Provider management first.
validationSecretIdUuid: Secret ID must be a valid UUID; do not enter an API key or token.
saveFailedRetry: Save failed. Please try again later.
savedNeedVerify: {name} saved. Verify later before Tools can use it reliably.
savedDraftOnly: {name} saved only; verification status was reset.
savedButVerifyRequestFailed: Connection saved, but verification request failed: {message}
savedButVerifyNeedsAttention: {name} saved, but verification still needs attention: {detail}
savedButVerifyNeedsAttentionWithRefresh: {name} saved, but verification still needs attention ({detail}); {refreshError}
deleteConfirmHasInput: Delete confirmation has input; cancel or complete deletion.
deleteConfirmNameRequired: Type the connection name to confirm deletion.
deleteFailedRetry: Delete failed. Please try again later.
authModeInstructionDefault: Auth protocol is managed by the Provider; enter only environment account fields and one-time credentials here.
verifyFailureHint: Check the Provider verification URL, auth, and network connectivity.
verifyDiagnosticsHint: After verification, stable diagnostic codes from the backend appear here.
clipboardBlocked: This browser blocked automatic copy; select the text manually.
unsavedFormWarning: The form has unsaved changes; confirm discard in the dialog before closing.
